title: Rebates: customer financial assistance delivery
summary: This page provides information about financial assistance options, including rebates, grants, and vouchers, that Service NSW offers.

internal_links.text: Learn more about Service NSW digital capabilities

faqs.q: What types of financial assistance are available?
faqs.a: Service NSW offers rebates, grants, and vouchers to help with costs.

faqs.q: Where can I find more information about grants?
faqs.a: You can learn more about grants at the Grants page.

faqs.q: How can I get information about digital vouchers?
faqs.a: Information on digital vouchers is available on the Vouchers page.
